en.name: Ojach
en.description: Hi, I'm a solo web developer based in Japan.I'm the creator of One Page. One App. (1P1A), a page-first approach to Progressive Web Apps. I build WordPress plugins and web tools that make it easy to turn individual web pages into installable home screen apps.Most articles on this site are first written in Japanese and then translated into English. While the English may not always be perfect, every article is based on extensive real-device testing with iPhone, Android, Safari, Chrome, Web App Manifest, Service Workers, and modern PWA architecture.
